name: Imperial Dromedarii

abilities.name: Precision Shot
abilities.text: Improved missile weapon damage for an extended period. These values are further modified by the unit itself.

abilities.name: Rapid Advance
abilities.text: Improved unit movement speed over an extended period.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

attributes.name: Fire Whilst Moving
attributes.text: This unit can fire when mounted and moving.

attributes.name: Parthian Shot
attributes.text: This unit can fire all around and not just in-front of itself.

attributes.name: Resistant to Heat
attributes.text: This unit tires less quickly in the desert.

attributes.name: Scare (horses)
attributes.text: This unit gives a morale penalty to enemy horses.

short: Versatile camel-mounted auxiliary troops, well-suited to the local terrain.
history: 'Dromedarii' were camel-riding auxiliary troops recruited in the eastern provinces of the Roman Empire and designed to take the place of light horse cavalry when fighting in desert conditions. Although useful for screening infantry and scouting ahead, they were also used to counter horsemen, due to the natural aversion of horses to the smell of camels. Due to their geographical location dromedarii were peculiar to the Eastern Romans, providing a useful indigenous cavalry force for fighting along their frontier with Sassanid Persia.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
